source.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា
source.description: Preparation exam — function exercise I: f(x) = (x^2+3x+6)/(x+2) — decomposition, oblique asymptote, position, derivative, extrema, limits.
source.extracted_by: manual transcription from preparation exam (2026-08), answers verified with SymPy

prompt:
We have the function f defined by f(x) = (x^2 + 3x + 6)/(x + 2).
1. Find the real numbers a, b, c such that f(x) = ax + b + c/(x+2).
2. Show that the line (d) with equation y = x + 1 is an oblique asymptote of the graph (C) of f.
3. Study the position of (C) relative to (d).
4. Compute the derivative of f and find the extrema of f.
5. Compute the limits of f at -2, at -infinity and at +infinity. Deduce the vertical asymptote of (C). Draw (C) and (d).
prompt_latex: \text{គេមានអនុគមន៍ } f \text{ ដែល } f(x)=\frac{x^2+3x+6}{x+2} .\\ \text{1. កំណត់ចំនួនពិត } a, b, c \text{ ដែល } f(x)=ax+b+\frac{c}{x+2} .\\ \text{2. បង្ហាញថាបន្ទាត់ } (d):\ y=x+1 \text{ ជាអាស៊ីមតូតទ្រេតនៃក្រាប } (C) \text{ តាងអនុគមន៍ } f .\\ \text{3. សិក្សាទីតាំងធៀបរវាងក្រាប } (C) \text{ និងបន្ទាត់ } (d) .\\ \text{4. គណនាដេរីវេនៃ } f \text{ រួចរកបរមាធៀបនៃ } f .\\ \text{5. គណនាលីមីតនៃ } f \text{ ត្រង់ } -2 \text{ ; } -\infty \text{ និង } +\infty \text{ រួចទាញរកអាស៊ីមតូតឈរនៃក្រាប } (C) \text{ និងសង់ក្រាប } (C),\ (d) .

parts.question_km: កំណត់ចំនួនពិត $a, b, c$ ដែល $f(x) = ax + b + \frac{c}{x+2}$
parts.technique: Divide x²+3x+6 by x+2: (x+2)(x+1) = x²+3x+2, remainder 4. So f(x) = x+1 + 4/(x+2): a=1, b=1, c=4.

parts.question_km: បង្ហាញថាបន្ទាត់ $(d): y = x+1$ ជាអាស៊ីមតូតទ្រេតនៃក្រាប $(C)$
parts.technique: From part 1, f(x) - (x+1) = 4/(x+2) → 0 as x → ±∞, so (d): y = x+1 is the oblique asymptote of (C).

parts.question_km: សិក្សាទីតាំងធៀបរវាងក្រាប $(C)$ និងបន្ទាត់ $(d)$
parts.technique: f(x) - (x+1) = 4/(x+2), which is positive exactly when x+2 > 0, i.e. x > -2. So (C) is above (d) on (-2, ∞) and below on (-∞, -2).

parts.question_km: គណនាដេរីវេនៃ $f$ រួចរកបរមាធៀបនៃ $f$
parts.technique: f'(x) = 1 - 4/(x+2)² = ((x+2)² - 4)/(x+2)² = x(x+4)/(x+2)². Critical points x = -4 and x = 0: local maximum at x=-4 (f=-5), local minimum at x=0 (f=3).

parts.question_km: គណនាលីមីតនៃ $f$ ត្រង់ $-2$ ; $-\infty$ និង $+\infty$ រួចទាញរកអាស៊ីមតូតឈរ
parts.technique: As x → -2⁻ the numerator → 4 > 0 and x+2 → 0⁻ so f → -∞; as x → -2⁺, f → +∞ (so x = -2 is the vertical asymptote). f(x) = x+1+4/(x+2) behaves like x, so f → -∞ at -∞ and +∞ at +∞.
